title: Margaye saqqae haram haye haye
body:
Margaye Saqqaye haram haye haye, Sheh ki kamar hogayi qam haye haye.
Neher pe Abbas ke shane kate, Lut gaye Sultane umam haye haye.
Gham se kamar toot gayi Shah ki, Uth nahi sakte hain qadam haye haye.
Sar bhi Alamdar ka shaq hogaya, Hogaye bazu bhi qalam haye haye.
Mit gaya ab fouje Khuda ka nishan, Khoon mein duba hai alam haye haye.
Kehte the Sheh bhai ke shaida utho, Ghere hain sab ahle sitam haye haye.
